##### Project general facts

Supreme Residence by Unistate is a luxurious and comfortable apartment complex, offering an exquisite living destination that combines luxury, comfort, and style in the heart of a vibrant city. Featuring spacious layouts with various floor plans including studios and one and two-bedroom units, each residence is a testament to architectural brilliance. The apartments are flooded with natural light and feature modern finishes for a contemporary aesthetic, creating a sanctuary where residents can unwind and indulge in the finest amenities.

Residents enjoy a range of vibrant facilities designed to enhance everyday living, including a swimming pool, a state-of-the-art gym, a dedicated barbecue area for outdoor gatherings, and a well-equipped play area perfect for children of all ages. Covered parking, round-the-clock security, and a helpful concierge service ensure a fulfilling and hassle-free living experience, providing residents with everything they need taken care of.

Every apartment at Supreme Residence features large windows that allow natural light to illuminate the space and create a bright atmosphere, complemented by modern finishes that provide a contemporary and stylish aesthetic. Sleek kitchens are equipped with high-quality appliances, and well-appointed bathrooms are carefully considered to enhance comfort and convenience. Each residence is a stroke of brilliance, where every detail is designed to elevate the living experience.

##### Location description and benefits

Nestled in Arjan, a residential community near popular Dubai attractions such as Dubai Miracle Garden and Mall of the Emirates, this exceptional location offers a family-friendly environment with a safe and secure atmosphere. The community features landscaped gardens, swimming pools, fitness centers, and retail outlets, while several schools, healthcare facilities, and supermarkets make it a convenient place to live.

The location is distinguished by its excellent connectivity to the rest of Dubai through Dubai-Al Ain Road, Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road, and Al Khail Road. Parks and playgrounds provide residents with opportunities for outdoor activities and recreation, creating a balanced and active lifestyle.

For those seeking a residence that embodies luxury, community connection, and a prime Dubai address, Arjan delivers an unmatched lifestyle. Its unique combination of natural beauty, world-class amenities, and strategic connectivity makes it one of Dubai's most desirable destinations. This is a place where one can enjoy the best of city living.
